source.title: Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two contests were nominated; John S. Browne (U.) withdrew in Middle Liberties, leaving Patrick G. Coyle returned unopposed. Only Ardmore was actually polled. Anti-Partitionist. Mr. John S. Browne (U.) withdrew his nomination after the nominations were lodged. Returned unopposed.
